items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: they had Big Anderson on trumpet, Roy Evans on drum, Willie O'Connell guitar, I was playing piano, and Sam Lee, tenor sax

ctx.x: Yeah, I worked there with, they had Big Anderson on trumpet, Roy Evans on drum, Willie O'Connell guitar, I was playing piano, and Sam Lee, tenor sax, a fellow by the name Cyril was playing the first sax. Cyril, huh? Cyril, yeah. He went away, we don't know, nobody knew what happened, never to hear him, no more of it. He left him. He stayed there a good while? Oh yeah, he stayed there for a while. Was Sam Morgan living then or not, do you know?
Sam, no Sam Morgan was dead, but I don't know if he was dead, Andrew Morgan, trumpet player.
